tldr: Pluto in the 7th house: power becomes personal through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
body:
With Pluto in the 7th house, this part of you intensifies partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict. Pluto describes power, pressure, truth, control, fear, attachment, and deep change. In practice, this brings attention to the one-to-one dynamics that show you how you meet others and how you let yourself be met.

When this placement is supported, relationship patterns can become clearer while there is still room to choose differently. Pluto can become depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried.

When it is strained, you may hand too much power to the other person or make them carry the whole story. The harder pattern can show up as control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change.
gift: depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried expressed through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
challenge: control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change around partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
